recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下，在大量小淋巴球與粉紅色組織球之間，散在幾顆大型細胞，核呈空泡狀、輪廓不規則或分葉，有些具明顯核仁；小淋巴球背景中的散在大型異型細胞是 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞（popcorn cell）線索。
features: Scattered large cells with vesicular, irregular to lobated nuclei and distinct nucleoli
Large cells have moderate pale-to-amphophilic cytoplasm
Background of numerous small round lymphocytes with dense chromatin
Interspersed histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional apoptotic body; no eosinophils or plasma-cell-rich mixed background
describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a lymphoid infiltrate composed predominantly of small mature lymphocytes and histiocytes with eosinophilic cytoplasm. Interspersed are scattered large atypical cells with vesicular, irregular or lobated nuclei and distinct nucleoli. The mixed background lacks prominent eosinophils or plasma cells, and sheets of large cells are not seen. The findings are consistent with LP cells in a lymphocyte- and histiocyte-rich background, in keeping with nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with a variant pattern; immunohistochemistry and architecture are needed to exclude T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cytology is similar; THRLBCL is defined by diffuse growth without small-B-cell nodules or FDC meshworks.
Mixed cellularity shows binucleate HRS cells with large eosinophilic nucleoli and a background rich in eosinophils and plasma cells, which is not seen here.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells across the background rather than scattered large B cells among bland small lymphocytes.
